title: SRS Registry
description: An ext:registry registry (RFC-049): one catalog of entries by kind, each mapping an identity to a locator, held outside everything it lists. A published catalog fills in its catalog fields; an operator's own list of repositories carries entries only. The entry rules (RFC-049 [R3], [R4], [R14]) are rules, not schema constraints, so that a malformed entry fails only itself ([R15]) and an entry of a kind defined later still validates. The held form and the travelling form are this one document, written by RFC-003 [C5]'s canonical JSON rules ([R9]). The top level is closed, as every production schema is (rfc-decision-2e0cd70a); a writer still keeps top-level properties it does not understand on rewrite, and the validation complaint is their diagnostic.

entries.description: The registry's entries. Each states its kind and a locator in the LOCATOR shape; its other fields are defined by its kind (RFC-049 [R14]): package (identity packageId and packageVersion) or repository (identity id; optional readOnly). Ordered by kind, then by the kind's identity fields, then by the entry's own canonical serialization ([R9]).

registryRevision.description: The registry's own generation counter, counting registry shapes only (RFC-049 [R9]). This shape is 1; an absent stamp reads as 0, a catalog written before RFC-049, which a reader brings forward by the 0-to-1 transformer. A reader refuses a registry stamped above its supported revision.

schemaVersion.description: SRS spec version the catalog was written against, e.g. '2.0'. Nothing gates on it; the generation is registryRevision alone.

registryId.description: Optional catalog metadata. Nothing resolves by it.

registryName.description: Display name of a published catalog.

updatedAt.description: When a published catalog was last updated.
